property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any addresses, transfer either returns true without reverting (when all inner calls succeed) or reverts; it never returns false — i.e., if it returns then it must be true and have attempted calls to each _tos entry.
If _tos has length 1, transfer either reverts or returns true (it never returns false) when invoked with any inputs.
If _tos is non-empty, transfer must either revert or return true (it never returns false) when called with any inputs.
For any single-element _tos array the transfer call either reverts or returns true (never returns false).
